definitions.full: H4041. megammah [ מְגַמָּה ] noun feminine Hab 1:9 (of the Chaldaeans) קָדִ֑ימָה מְּנֵיהֶם מְגַמַּת , of uncertain meaning: Ges the assembling of their faces is (directed) forwards; Ew De Ke eagerness , comparing (questionably) גָּמָא swallow Job 39:4 , and (Frey) seek (whence St proposes מְגֻמַת ).
